title: Mystical Mushroom Soup

{{Infobox/Item |type = Consumable item |rarity = rare |collection = Mushroom 7 |lore = Consuming this Magical Mushroom Soup on your private island allows the player to fly for {{Green|200 minutes}}. Leaving the private island will pause the effect! |sell = 640 |bazaar = Mystical Mushroom Soup |raw_materials = 3 Planks *160 Red Mushroom *160 Brown Mushroom *160 Redstone *160 Glowstone Dust |mat_cost_bazaar = *1x Dark Oak Wood *1x Enchanted Red Mushroom *1x Enchanted Brown Mushroom *1x Enchanted Redstone Dust *1x Enchanted Glowstone Dust |auctionable = n |upgrades_from = Magical Mushroom Soup |id = SUPER_MAGIC_MUSHROOM_SOUP }} '''Mystical Mushroom Soup''' is a {{Rare}} consumable unlocked in {{CollectionLink|Mushroom 7}} that allows players to fly on [[Private Island]]s. == Usage == When consumed, '''Mystical Mushroom Soup''' gives the player 200 minutes of flight on private islands. It also makes them invulnerable to fall damage while on their private island, which is useful when building farms. This soup can be a cheaper flight substitute for players without a [[Booster Cookie]]. However, the flight duration is limited and one should be aware if it is about to run out and drink more preemptively, or else you will fall and take damage or possibly die. The flight duration can be extended by consuming additional soup. Mystical Mushroom Soup's duration will pause when leaving the island, resuming when one returns. Warning messages will trigger when there are 60, 30, 10, 5, 4, 3, 2, and 1 second(s) left and when the effect runs out. == Obtaining == Mystical Mushroom Soup can be obtained through crafting. === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Mushroom 7}} |A1 = |B1 = Enchanted Glowstone Dust |C1 = |A2 = Enchanted Red Mushroom |B2 = Enchanted Brown Mushroom |C2 = Enchanted Redstone Dust |A3 = |B3 = Bowl |C3 = |Output = Mystical Mushroom Soup }} }} == Game Message == {| class="wikitable" ! already active |{{Dialogue| &e&oHmm... tasty! &aYour flight has been extended for &c200 &aextra minutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oI feel like I can fly! &aYour flight has been extended for &c200 &aextra minutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oWhat was in that soup? &aYour flight has been extended for &c200 &aextra minutes. }} |- |class="ct" |Effect about to expire |{{Dialogue|&cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e10s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e5s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e4s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e3s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e2s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e1s &cMushroom Soup Flight has expired!}} |} == Trivia == * This was announced by a former {{RN|a|Dctr}}, on June 4th, 2020. * Although it requires 160 times as many resources as [[Magical Mushroom Soup]], it lasts 100 times as long, making it a less efficient use of resources. * It was previously known as "Super Magical Mushroom Soup". * The max flight duration is about 596,523 hours, or 2,147,483,647 seconds, which is the 32-bit signed integer limit. This amount of soup would cost {{BZC|*33555 Oak Wood *178957 Enchanted Redstone Dust *178957 Enchanted Glowstone Dust *178957 Enchanted Brown Mushroom *178957 Enchanted Red Mushroom}}.  ** This record was discovered and reached by Cekofari. Upon reaching this limit, the flight duration timer disappears, flying gets disabled, and eating additional soup does not re-enable flight. The only known way to regain flight on the private island is to eat a booster cookie. *The first record was held by Zylenox, who had gotten 520,000 hours of flight, which he explained would last until he died in real lifehttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6oatMZva0jU&t=85s. **The next record was held by MaybeMoshi who beat Zylenox's record with 521,001 hourshttps://hypixel.net/threads/mushroom-soup-record-broken.5342206/. **This record was ultimately broken by Cekofari when he hit the limit of 596,523 hours. * The Mystical Mushroom Soup used to have a different appearance and gave the Nausea effect when consumed. ** The Nausea effect has been removed and Mystical Mushroom Soup was given a different appearance and not considered a Mushroom Soup from vanilla Minecraft. ** The custom Mystical Mushroom Soup was added because the vanilla Mushroom Soup interfered with the mechanics of the soup and caused it to not stack when crafted. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2020/June 4|link=https://hypixel.net/threads/june-4-super-magical-mushroom-soup.2970703/|[[File:Magical Mushroom Soup (old).png|26px]] Added '''Super Magical Mushroom Soup'''.|Renamed item to '''Mystical Mushroom Soup'''.}} {{History|2021/Oct 13|Changed from an actual mushroom soup item to a custom head item, as well as changed texture from [[File:Magical Mushroom Soup (old).png|26px]] to [[File:Mystical Mushroom Soup.png|26px]].|Removed Nausea Effect.}} {{History|0.18.3|Added '''Mystical Mushroom Soup''' to the [[Bazaar]].}} }} == References == == Navigation == {{Nav/Collection/Mushroom}}
